entry.content:
M=> This is Mathican

This is the first post of a test of the Publii static site generator. I’ve got to say - I am quite impressed, I like Publii a lot. I think it will work quite well as a launch mechanism for mathican.net, hosted on Github pages. Well done peeps at Publii.
